_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Sustaining Engineering Project Status Report
summary: Documents the status of contractor effort toward achieving contract objectives, identifying accomplishments, difficulties, and progress against planned goals for Government monitoring and evaluation of contractor performance.
use_relationship:
The Status Report documents the status of contractor effort towards achieving contract objectives. It identifies accomplishments to date and difficulties encountered, and compare the status achieved to planned goals and the resources expended. It is used by the Government to monitor and evaluate contractor performance.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract SOW.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Status Report shall be in contractor format.

children.title: Identification
children.content: The data indicated below shall be contained on a title page or on the first page of the report.

children.title: Page size
children.content: The report shall be on 8 1/2 by 11 inch (metric A4 paper)

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Organizational structure
children.content: The plan shall present an organizational chart and supporting narrative portraying the contractor's business (corporate) structure. It shall describe the functional relationships and responsibilities among the organizational elements that will participate in the accomplishment of the contractual commitments.

children.title: Program management
children.content: The plan shall present an organizational chart and supporting narrative describing the management office the contractor established to manage the contractual commitment. The plan shall define the direct lines of control, responsibilities, functional relationships, and authority between the management office and the contractor's other organization elements. The plan shall also describe all interfaces between the contractor and the Government.

children.title: Personnel
children.content: The plan shall list the personnel staffing of the contractor's management office that directs the contractual tasks, projects, and programs and assist in completing the contract. The listing shall include the security clearance that personnel require to fill these positions.

children.title: The Contractor shall track the status of the core and non-core activities accomplished during the month
children.content: The Contractor shall include the following;

children.title: Maintenance Working Group (MWG) open items (as applicable)
Service Actions reviewed and Service Action Support Report (status listing)
